title: Coven automation event (coven.automations.event.v1)
description: Changefeed event for automation lifecycle. Cursors are monotonic integers; replay from any cursor is deterministic and duplicate delivery is reduced exactly once per event id.

cursor.description: Monotonic position in the automation changefeed.

id.description: Globally unique event id; the reducer deduplicates on it.

at.description: RFC3339 UTC instant the event was recorded.

payload.description: Redacted event payload; never carries prompt text, credentials, or private memory.
